description: This Java class provides utility methods for calculating and tracking a user's reading goals, including progress estimation, schedule adherence, and counts of books/pages read within the year.

classes.name: ReadingGoalCalculator
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for calculating reading goals, progress, and schedule adherence based on books read and total targets.

methods.name: shouldHaveRead
methods.description: Calculates the expected number of books that should have been read by this point in the year to stay on target.

methods.name: booksToReadFromStartOfYear
methods.description: Calculates the weekly average number of books to read from the start of the year given the total goal.

methods.name: howManyReadThisYear
methods.description: Determines how many books or pages have been read this year based on the goal type and shelf.

methods.name: bookHasFinishDateInThisYear
methods.description: Checks if a given book has a finish date within the current year.

methods.name: howFarAheadOrBehindSchedule
methods.description: Computes the absolute difference between the expected progress and actual books read, indicating schedule deviation.

methods.name: calculateProgressTowardsReadingGoal
methods.description: Returns the fraction of the reading goal achieved based on books read versus total to read.

methods.name: behindOrAheadSchedule
methods.description: Returns a string indicating whether the user is ahead or behind schedule based on books read and expected progress.
